title: Add encrypted backup uploads to cloud drives
context: Upload the latest encrypted `backup.7z` and its checksum to cloud drives through rclone.

spec.summary: Add encrypted backup uploads to cloud drives
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: rclone remotes are configured for the supported providers.
The remote checksum is verified after upload.
At least one provider restores successfully in a drill.
Tokens live outside the repository, mode 600.
A failed provider does not remove the local or previous remote copy.
No media or observability data is uploaded.
